commit_message: feat: add token bucket rate limiter
summary: New TokenBucket with four unit tests that execute every line but pin almost nothing.

defects.description: The exact boundary where cost equals the available tokens is never tested, so `self.tokens >= cost` -> `>` survives (cargo-mutants does not generate this mutant; it needs a hand-applied mutation or a careful read). A test such as new(3, ..) then try_acquire(3) must succeed.

`rejects_when_empty` asks for cost 5 from a bucket of capacity 2, which is rejected regardless of state, so the test never proves the first acquire consumed tokens. Mutating `self.tokens -= cost` to `+=` or `/=` survives. The test should request a cost that would succeed on a full bucket (e.g. 1) after draining it.

`never_exceeds_capacity` only asserts `available() > 0`, so the `.min(capacity)` cap in refill is unpinned; removing the cap (or returning any positive count) passes. It should assert `available() == 5` (minus the acquired token, i.e. 4) after a long idle period.

`refills_over_time` waits 5 s at 2 tokens/s and only checks that one token is available, so the refill arithmetic (`elapsed * rate` -> `/` or `+`) survives. The test should pin the exact number of tokens refilled (e.g. available() == 10 after 5 s, or a short wait that yields exactly N tokens).
